off.error: no chunks: the plan retrieved nothing (a failed run is not scored as a loss)

stop_detail: H03 top1: the envelope or one of its steps has no cost_usd

orderings.calibrated: envelope chunks sorted by calibrated distance (carried distance x model factor when the chunks span more than one model), ascending, none last; changed from raw distance, the pre-declared primary, after the first partial run (Sam 2026-11-19, 134-research-17)
orderings.envelope: envelope order: each retrieval step's own ranking, steps in plan order (printed, not decided on)
orderings.distance: envelope chunks sorted by raw carried distance (the ordering of 134-research-13; printed, not decided on)

scope_notes: A pass licenses the default for nx_answer's search and query steps whose scope names no other domain and no topic, on this corpus, over the plans the questions matched (plan_id per arm), judged on retrieved chunks; it says nothing about answer quality.

The 25 RDR questions are in-sample (all among leg 1's 26). 'Out-of-sample' (title + generic) means not used to choose the design; the title questions were measured before (134-research-13), so they are not unseen. The primary ordering was changed after the first partial run's generic questions (GD01-GD08) had been seen, on their raw-distance and envelope scores; their calibrated scores had not been computed.
The off arm can grow a plan that the top1 arm then matches (nx_answer saves ad-hoc plans); pairs that ran different plans are flagged. The run writes those plans to the T2 plan library.
